correctness.rationale: Diagonal invertible rescaling and coordinate sign changes reduce any box to the standard centered cube and normal coefficients a_i=s_i |u_i|. Active support at most three gives product of a centrally symmetric polygon (or segment/point) with intervals, hence a zonotope. Dominance makes the section the graph of a full cube. Otherwise every active-coordinate facet is an offset section of >=3 active cube coordinates. Its capped-simplex y_i in [0,b_i], sum delta=(sum b_i-|t|)/2 has forced hypothetical center coordinate min(b_i,delta)/2, but when no coefficient dominates the truncated sum strictly exceeds 2delta, contradicting the center lying in the slicing hyperplane. The obstruction is a nonsymmetric exposed face, impossible for a zonoid. Boundary equality and inactive factors are covered. Independently computed exact off-center 3-coordinate vertex reflections for all weights 1..3 and positive integral feasible offsets and found agreement; the analytic proof covers real parameters.
